hero_subtitle: Manage all your birds, cages, breeding couples, eggs, chicks, and breeding history from one powerful platform.
features_subheading: Everything you need to manage your bird breeding business
feature_birds_desc: Manage all birds, IDs, species, colors, sex, parents, and breeding history.
feature_cage_desc: Organize and track all cages and the birds inside them.
feature_couples_desc: Create and manage breeding pairs and track their breeding activity.
feature_eggs_desc: Record eggs, incubation dates, expected hatch dates, and chicks.
feature_tree_desc: Track the parents and generations of every bird.
feature_qr_desc: Generate unique QR codes for every bird, cage, and breeding couple. Scan to access details instantly.
qr_desc: Every bird, cage, and breeding couple can have its own unique QR code. Scan the code with your phone and instantly access detailed information, breeding history, genealogy, and current status.
benefits_subheading: From daily records to long-term family history, Wakr keeps every important detail organized and ready when you need it.
benefit_records_desc: All your breeding records in one place
benefit_history_desc: Track every bird's family tree and genealogy
benefit_mobile_desc: Access your data from phone or computer anytime
benefit_qr_desc: Quick identification with unique QR codes
benefit_stats_desc: Track breeding results and performance metrics
footer_desc: The complete bird breeding management solution for modern breeders.
